initial_run.interrupted_scenario: Mobile confetti and the centered waiting hint remain clear through themes, narrow screens and rotation
initial_run.cause: The controlled test clock advanced before WebKit delivered the native viewport resize.
initial_run.resolution: The test now waits for native viewport delivery before advancing its clock; the single failed scenario passed on rerun. Production HTML did not change.
initial_run.result_recovery: The first six functional results were recovered from captured PASS output. Runtime console and request lists from that interrupted run were not preserved; the runtime_log_coverage field names the scenario with recorded logs.
